checks.evidence: Test 'Train orientation defined by active cab' step 1 only checks that the front of the train is the active cab side. It has no movement, no balise group or LRBG, and no check of nominal orientation relative to the LRBG.

Test 'Train orientation defined by last active cab when no cab is active' steps 1-2: with no cab active, the OBU retains the orientation defined by the last active cab. The LRBG-relative nominal value is not stated, but the behaviour is equivalent.
